leadStory: Andoni Iraola's first Liverpool team beat Sunderland 4-2 in Nashville, a Dominik Szoboszlai screamer among four goals from a young side, before Joe Gomez limped off injured inside eight minutes.
subject: A floodlit stadium at night, a ball caught in flight arcing toward the top corner of a goal, a lone player following through after a long-range strike
prompt: Cinematic editorial photograph, night, a vast dark grandstand under a bank of cold white floodlights, a green pitch tilting up and glowing, a football frozen in mid-flight arcing into the top corner of a goal net at the far post, a single player in the middle distance caught in the follow-through of a long-range strike, small in a wide frame, a warm glow of celebration rising against the cool floodlight, film grain, the charge of a decisive goal, no on-image text, headroom at the top for a masthead headline
